topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I've been mulling over what you asked, about using a bit of my yard for your garden. I've been tending this land since I could hold a hoe, and my father before that. Every inch is hard-earned, and the soil doesn’t give anything freely. There’s debts to settle, and the saints know the last harvest was lean. I reckon if the weather doesn't favor us, we might see another thin crop. Mind you, I’ve got my own kin to think of, and the boundaries here are often drawn by the mercy of the earth, not by the need of neighbors. I’ll pray on it, and may the saints guide my heart to the right choice. But for now, the earth holds all the answers, and it’s not a generous one these days.
